notes.stream: HLS master/media playlist served by tv.playitforme.online/api/proxy/<uuid>. The URL carries a short-lived signed `token` query parameter (a few minutes of life) and the endpoint only answers when a `Referer: https://canaletvlive.online/...` header is sent — so the app has to fetch a fresh token server-side and proxy the playlist and its segments.
notes.embed: kind=embed streams are player pages of the same provider (rd.playitforme.online/api/ch/<name>) or a third-party .htm player; they are meant to be loaded in an iframe.
notes.hd: The source exposes no structured HD flag (the HD badge on the watch page is static template chrome), so `hd` is null everywhere. `hdMention`/`hdEvidence` record the site's own prose claim.
notes.logo: Served from two interchangeable prefixes: /api/uploads/… and /uploads/… (WebP, JPG or PNG).
